county: Los Angeles County, California (Long Beach / Bixby Knolls / Lakewood area)
disambiguation_notes: The TARGET is the Los Angeles County Rancho Los Cerritos (Long Beach), a partition of the 1784 Nieto grant; adobe built 1844 by John (Juan) Temple; sold 1866 to Flint, Bixby & Co.; sheep/cattle operation.

NAME COLLISION 1: Robert B. Honeyman Jr. called his private museum/residence near Mission San Juan Capistrano (ORANGE COUNTY) 'Rancho Los Cerritos'. Huntington photo items p15150coll5/16479-16486 depict THAT Orange County residence, NOT the Long Beach ranch. Excluded from this inventory.
NAME COLLISION 2: 'Rancho Potrero de los Cerritos' is in Alameda County -- different land.

NAME COLLISION 3: The modern City of Cerritos (LA County) and 'Los Cerritos' place-names near Placentia are later/other; Southern California Edison photo collection (Huntington p16003coll2) hits are the modern Cerritos area, not the ranch.

physical_only_collections: Rancho Los Cerritos Historic Site -- Research Library & Archives, 4600 Virginia Road, Long Beach, CA 90807. Email Rancho@RanchoLosCerritos.org (appointment only, Wed/Thu). Holds 15,000+ artifacts and archival material to the 1940s: the 1872 William Godfrey stereograph cards of the ranch (earliest in-situ farm-labor photos in CA, showing Chinese and Mexican ranch hands), 1,100+ historic photographic views of the rancho and occupants, 1930-remodel architectural blueprints, Sarah Bixby Smith and Llewellyn Bixby Jr. manuscript collections. City of Long Beach owns the site.
Historical Society of Long Beach -- Long Beach, CA (regional photo/manuscript archive for Long Beach & Bixby history).
Long Beach Public Library, Long Beach History & Special Collections (LBPL Digital Photo Archive) -- 200 W. Broadway, Long Beach, CA; Rancho Los Cerritos among documented locations.
The Huntington Library, San Marino, CA -- Solano-Reeve survey maps (p15150coll4) and Photographs collections; onsite reading room for higher-resolution/rights beyond the ambiguous web statement.

Bancroft Library, UC Berkeley -- Robert B. Honeyman Jr. Collection (OAC finding aid ark:/13030/tf9p3012wq); NOTE Honeyman's own 'Rancho Los Cerritos' was his SAN JUAN CAPISTRANO (Orange County) residence, a name-collision -- verify content before associating with the Long Beach ranch.
